full_judgment: A.T.M. Afzal CJ.:- A decree for Tk.3,93,145.00 was passed against the petitioners in Money suit No.11. of 1995 of the Court of Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Tangail, filed by the plaintiff Bank. The petitioners filed an appreciation for correction of the decree which was rejected whereupon they took a revision against the said order and prayed for an order of stay of the impugned judgment and decree pending disposal of the Rule.
